name: Content Reveal Countdown
author: mahethekiller

sections.description:
Content Reveal Countdown is the ultimate WordPress plugin for scheduling content visibility. Create beautiful countdown timers that automatically hide your content until specific dates and times, then reveal it automatically when the countdown ends.

Boost Engagement & Build Anticipation

  • Scheduled Content Release: Set exact dates and times for content to become visible
  • Beautiful Timer Designs: Choose from 4 professionally designed countdown styles
  • Increase User Engagement: Build anticipation and keep visitors coming back
  • Flexible Display Options: Show timers on specific pages or site-wide
  • Admin-Friendly: Disable timers for admin users for easy testing

Perfect For

  • Product Launches: Build hype before big releases
  • Course Content: Time-based lesson releases
  • Event Countdowns: Create excitement for upcoming events
  • Special Announcements: Schedule important updates
  • Membership Sites: Time-gated content for subscribers
  • Limited Time Offers: Create urgency for promotions

Key Features

  • Date-Based Scheduling: Set exact end dates for content visibility
  • 4 Beautiful Designs: Modern, Classic, Minimal, and Elegant timer styles
  • Page-Specific Control: Show timers on selected pages only
  • Admin Disable Option: Test without seeing timers as admin
  • Mobile Responsive: Works perfectly on all devices
  • SEO Friendly: Doesn’t affect your search engine rankings
  • Lightweight: Fast loading with minimal performance impact

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the content-reveal-countdown folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Content Reveal > Settings to configure your countdown timers
  4. Set your end date and choose a beautiful timer design
  5. Select whether to show timers on specific pages or site-wide
sections.faq:
Can I set different countdown times for different pages?

Yes! You can select specific pages where the countdown timer should appear, and set different end dates for each page.

What happens after the countdown ends?

The timer automatically disappears and your content becomes permanently visible to all visitors.

Is the timer mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! All timer designs are fully responsive and work perfectly on smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers.

Can I customize the timer appearance?

The plugin includes 4 professionally designed timer styles. Choose the one that best matches your website’s design.

Will the timer affect my SEO?

No, the plugin is SEO-friendly. Search engines can still access your content while maintaining user experience.
